MembershipPricing.intro: Start with a free, evidence-backed price check. Paid memberships add more property slots, a longer exact daily price-check window, scheduled analysis and deeper operating tools.
MembershipPricing.taxNote: Monthly launch prices in New Zealand dollars, including GST. No annual commitment. Paid plans can only be selected after their production launch gate opens.

MembershipPricing.coverageTitle: Property slots and price coverage are different things
MembershipPricing.coverageIntro: Your plan controls how many physical properties you can monitor and how far ahead Tymra can produce exact daily decisions. Broader monitoring is contextual — it is never presented as continuously observed daily pricing.
MembershipPricing.propertyBody: An address and supported OTA links matched to the same accommodation share one property slot. Changing the URL or address spelling does not create a new allowance.
MembershipPricing.dailyBody: Within this window, Tymra attempts an evidence-backed target-price decision for each New Zealand stay date covered by your plan.
MembershipPricing.monitoringBody: Tymra watches relevant market signals and selected OTA dates farther ahead, but clearly labels dates that have not received exact daily collection.
MembershipPricing.trustEyebrow: THE SAME EVIDENCE STANDARD ON EVERY PLAN
MembershipPricing.trustTitle: Higher plans add coverage and automation — not looser claims
MembershipPricing.trustPrice: If one supported OTA publishes a valid matching price, Tymra returns that observed price.
MembershipPricing.trustRecommendation: Price retrieval and price-adjustment recommendations are separate; weak comparison evidence never hides a valid observed price.
MembershipPricing.trustDecision: Tymra supports pricing decisions. It does not automatically change prices on an OTA or PMS.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.intro: How Tymra turns reliable observations into explainable decision support.
methodology.section1Body: The anonymous check uses stay dates, guest count and room context present in the OTA URL, or the OTA's observed default display configuration when those values are absent. The user is not asked to configure them.
methodology.section2Body: Only enabled, operationally healthy sources can support automatic publication. Rates are append-only and tied to a Collection Run.
methodology.section3Body: Confidence considers competitor count, freshness, fee completeness, listing context and comparability. Missing evidence lowers confidence or produces a clear limited result.
methodology.section4Body: Tymra may highlight up to five dates. Operators remain responsible for pricing decisions, and Tymra never changes prices automatically.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Practical answers about the current Price Check flow.
faq.section1Body: No. Tymra provides decision support only and does not connect to a PMS or automatically change rates.
faq.section2Body: Public accommodation links from Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia, Bookabach, Agoda and Trip.com are supported.
faq.section3Title: How are dates, guests and room type chosen?
faq.section3Body: Tymra uses values carried by the OTA link when present; otherwise it uses the OTA's observed default display configuration. New users are not asked to select these fields.
faq.section4Title: What if market evidence is limited?
faq.section4Body: If at least one valid target OTA price is collected, Tymra returns that observed price. Recommendation availability and confidence are assessed separately, and Tymra never invents missing evidence.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Release 1 privacy information for local development and review. Final legal approval is pending.
privacy.section1Body: Tymra processes service contact details, Price Check inputs, consent choices and operational records needed to deliver and audit the service.
privacy.section2Body: Service data supports property identification, analysis, result delivery, security, support and compliance. Marketing use requires separate consent.
privacy.section3Body: Sensitive values are encrypted or hashed where appropriate. Formal results require an authenticated account and server-side ownership checks; persistent bearer result links are not used.
privacy.section4Body: You may request access, correction or deletion through the contact form. Necessary non-personal audit history may be retained.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: Draft Release 1 service terms for local review. Final legal text is pending.
terms.section1Body: Tymra provides accommodation pricing intelligence and related service communications for supported New Zealand markets.
terms.section2Body: You remain responsible for verifying evidence, choosing prices and complying with platform, tax and consumer obligations.
terms.section3Body: Do not misuse the service, attempt unauthorized access or submit content you do not have the right to process.
terms.section4Body: Sources and market coverage may change. Tymra may return limited or unavailable outcomes where reliable evidence is not available.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: Cookies used by the local application.
cookies.section1Body: Tymra uses essential cookies for locale preference, anonymous abuse protection, customer access and administrator sessions.
cookies.section2Body: A secure HttpOnly cookie keeps the verified browser signed in to the customer account without exposing its session key to client scripts.
cookies.section3Body: Protected operational pages use a bounded, revocable HttpOnly session cookie.
cookies.section4Body: No external analytics service is required for local development. Any future analytics must follow consent and data-minimization rules.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: Understand the limits of Tymra pricing intelligence.
disclaimer.section1Body: Tymra does not provide financial, legal or guaranteed revenue advice and does not automatically change prices.
disclaimer.section2Body: Availability, fees, restrictions and competitor prices can change after collection. Results describe a point-in-time evidence set.
disclaimer.section3Body: A suggested review does not guarantee occupancy, demand, revenue or a specific market response.
disclaimer.section4Body: Operators should check current listing conditions and apply their own judgement before changing a rate.

deleteData.title: Request data deletion
deleteData.intro: Use the contact form to request deletion or de-identification of eligible personal data.
deleteData.section1Body: Provide the email used for the Price Check and, where available, the Price Check reference. Never send passwords, session details or other credentials.
deleteData.section2Body: Tymra may ask for proportionate verification before processing a request to prevent unauthorized deletion.
deleteData.section3Body: Necessary de-identified operational and audit history may be retained where it no longer identifies a person or is required for compliance.
deleteData.section4Body: A local development request receives a reference number. Production response timing and retention policy require final approval.
